basic_info.description: 4-plex Outer Sunset apartment building presents a fantastic investment opportunity. Each unit is 1bd/1ba with parking.  2 of 4 units are vacant and 2 long-term tenants with huge potential upside.  Each unit has a generously sized bedroom and spacious living room with good natural light, making each unit an inviting home for residents. #1 on the lower level was recently remodeled and offers modern finishes. #3 on the top floor features views of the ocean, has an updated kitchen, but is a cosmetic fixer as the floors, ceiling and some walls are damaged due to a recent roof leak. Building includes a laundry room, four storage units, and uncovered parking for 4+ cars. Located just blocks from Ocean Beach, MUNI lines N and 18, Hook Fish Co, Outerlands, Java Beach Cafe, Judahlicious, and more.
